title: CmdPal: Shelf (2/n) - Add recent commands to Home and quick access shelf
author: jiripolasek
summary: The Shelf 2/n head was fully re-reviewed after nine rewritten commits. The new command-context work resolves the prior extension-host companion concern, while seven pinned/recent ownership, shortcut, limit, placement, and matching-text concerns remain in the current code. Every old-head proposal has been invalidated and no review action is exposed until fresh current-head Copilot convergence is available.

phase0.note: All current checks including CLA, dependency review, x64, arm64, SDK, tests, intake, and telemetry pass. The automated visual-evidence note is not re-raised for a collaborator-authored stacked Shelf change, and the exact current head has a maintainer approval.

judgment.rationale: Full current-head range-diff and source review covered the four newly added commits and all previously supported finding locations. The new ICommandContextSource implementation and tests resolve the old provider-context companion finding. Seven other concerns remain supported, but the prior REQUEST_CHANGES payload targeted 0f584eec and has been removed pending the mandatory external current-head gate.
evidence: Live upstream head is 1252424672fb2954b02af2a9e836adffd37e9883 and source activity is covered through 2026-09-06T21:47:51Z.
The rewritten series adds command-context forwarding, JsonIgnore for RecentCommandsManager.IsEmpty, app-provider invalidation ordering, and injectable app-page resolution.
RecentCommandListItem now forwards extension host and provider context through ICommandContextSource, with focused tests; the prior preserve-recent-provider-context proposal is obsolete.

ComposeSections still assigns shortcuts from visual result.Count, TopLevelCommandResolver still resolves duplicate ownership in presentation order and stops scanning hidden pins at the visible limit, and SettingsModel still accepts undefined placement enum values.

The shelf still accepts the shared 1-10 recent limit although the current PR description promises at most five, and the two matching resource descriptions remain inconsistent with the intended stable/five-item behavior.

candidate_findings.title: Keep pinned access keys stable when recents come first

confidence.rationale: ComposeSections still assigns shortcut indexes from result.Count, so recent-first placement deterministically renumbers pins.

candidate_findings.title: Reserve configured pins beyond the display limit

confidence.rationale: The early break at the visible pin limit leaves later configured pins outside the ownership sets.

candidate_findings.title: Keep pinned commands in the pinned section

confidence.rationale: The recent-first branch still resolves history before pins, assigning shared commands to Recent despite the unpinned-recents contract.
The settings model still accepts undefined numeric enum values, while downstream consumers do not interpret them consistently.
CreateConfiguration still clamps recents to the shared maximum of 10 while the current PR description explicitly promises at most five shelf items.

candidate_findings.title: Describe the stable pinned shortcut order

confidence.rationale: The current resource says shortcuts start from the left, which would be false after implementing the PR's stated stable-pin behavior.

candidate_findings.title: Clarify that the shelf stops at five recent items

confidence.rationale: The current resource applies the full 1-10 selection to the shelf despite the PR's five-item shelf contract.
